name: Kasm Technologies
summary:
Kasm Technologies provides browser isolation, secure remote access, and containerised workspace platforms for secure cloud-native and enterprise environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Kasm environments across secure Kubernetes, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure platforms. From browser isolation and secure remote access through to application streaming and operational governance, we help teams create secure, scalable, and operationally consistent digital workspace environments.
overview:
Kasm Technologies helps organisations deliver secure browser isolation, remote access, and containerised workspaces through the Kasm Workspaces platform. The platform enables organisations to run isolated browsers, applications, and desktop environments within disposable container sessions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure.  

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Kasm environments across enterprise Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure. From secure browser isolation and remote workspaces through to operational governance, application streaming, and platform resilience, we help teams create environments that are secure, scalable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building secure platform foundations that support long-term operational resilience and secure remote access. This includes browser isolation, application streaming, observability, lifecycle management, secure access controls, and operational enablement across complex infrastructure environments.  

We help organisations reduce operational risk, improve platform security, and deliver secure digital workspace environments with confidence.
